mapper.select: INSERT INTO ai_gateway_snapshot_revision (tenant_id, current_revision, updated_at) VALUES (#{tenantId}, 1, #{now}) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id) DO UPDATE SET current_revision = ai_gateway_snapshot_revision.current_revision + 1, updated_at = #{now} RETURNING current_revision
SELECT tenant_id FROM ai_gateway_snapshot_revision ORDER BY tenant_id ASC
